title: Rationale Distribution Distillation via Flow Matching for Distributional Continuous Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling multiple chain-of-thought rationales from a language model can uncover correct solutions missed by a single attempt. However, these rationales are typically lengthy, making repeated autoregressive generation costly. Continuous latent reasoning offers a compact alternative, but point-valued methods condition repeated answer sampling on a single rationale, which can limit exploration of diverse paths and answer coverage. We thus propose rationale distribution distillation (RDD), training a conditional flow over fixed-length latent sequences by distilling from multiple textual reasoning paths. Furthermore, we expand the distillation targets through within-query mixup, interpolating between complete latent rationales for the same query. translated_title: 基于流匹配的推理链分布蒸馏实现分布式连续潜在推理
translated_abstract: 从语言模型中采样多条思维链推理依据能够发现单次尝试所遗漏的正确解。然而，这些推理依据通常十分冗长，使得反复进行自回归生成的代价高昂。连续潜在推理提供了一种紧凑的替代方案，但点值方法将重复的答案采样条件于单一推理依据之上，这可能限制对多样化路径的探索以及答案的覆盖范围。为此，我们提出了推理链分布蒸馏（RDD），通过从多条文本推理路径中蒸馏，训练一个定义在固定长度潜在序列上的条件流。此外，我们通过查询内混合进一步扩展蒸馏目标，在同一查询的完整潜在推理依据之间进行插值。该流以非自回归方式生成整个潜在序列，随后由一个冻结的语言模型从采样得到的推理依据上下文中自回归地解码出答案。实证结果表明，所得的分布……
tldr: 该论文提出推理链分布蒸馏（RDD），利用流匹配将多条文本推理路径蒸馏为固定长度潜在序列上的条件流，以非自回归方式生成潜在推理的完整分布，在大幅降低重复生成成本的同时提升答案覆盖率与推理路径的多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Rationale Distribution Distillation (RDD), which uses flow matching to distill multiple textual reasoning paths into a conditional flow over fixed-length latent sequences, generating entire latent rationales nonautoregressively to reduce generation cost while improving answer coverage and reasoning path diversity.
